method_summary: Frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1-RoboCasa365 backbone (5B params: Qwen3-VL-4B VLM + 36-layer DiT action head reading the VLM's own KV-cache) fine-tuned with rank-4 LoRA adapters on the VLM's language_model attention/MLP layers only, plus Phasor's own sparse end-to-end memory core (ImprovedHGRNGate + ModernHopfieldLayer + adaptive gate) applied to pooled VLM hidden states as an additive consolidation-loss regularizer. The DiT action head is never modified -- verified on every training run via exact weight-sum matching before/after (87388.32329446077, unchanged in all runs).
training_data: Real RoboCasa365 pretrain_human300 corpus (all 300 tasks: 65 atomic + 235 composite, verified 300/300 present on disk and 0/16 composite_unseen tasks leak in, per robocasa.utils.dataset_registry.TASK_SET_REGISTRY['pretrain300']). This is the protocol-compliant training data -- see 'protocol_correction' below for the earlier, invalid 34-task version.
protocol_correction: The RoboCasa365 leaderboard maintainer (sepnasiriany) flagged on PR #16 that the original submission's fine-tuning data (34 atomic_seen+composite_seen tasks only) does not satisfy the official protocol, which requires training on the full pretrain_human300 corpus (300 tasks) -- restricting training to eval-overlapping tasks makes the numbers incomparable to other entries. This submission was retrained from scratch on the full pretrain_human300 corpus (same seed/budget: 220 steps, batch 48) and fully re-evaluated. The results below are the real, protocol-compliant, submittable numbers.

baseline_frozen_xr1.description: Frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1-RoboCasa365, no fine-tuning -- reference point.

lora_plus_m7_pretrain300.description: LoRA + M7 memory-core consolidation, fine-tuned on the full, protocol-compliant pretrain_human300 corpus (300 tasks). This is the submission leg (Phasor_m7).
lora_plus_m7_pretrain300.note: Beats the frozen baseline on composite_unseen (+0.75pt) and is essentially tied on atomic_seen/composite_seen/overall (2500/2500 episodes, 0 errors).

training_config.lora_target_modules: VLM language_model attention (q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj) and MLP (gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj) Linear layers only
training_config.dit_action_head: frozen, untouched (verified via exact weight-sum invariant on every run)
training_config.training_data_pretrain300: Full RoboCasa365 pretrain_human300 corpus (300 tasks), verified 0/16 composite_unseen tasks leak in

notes: A real bug was found and fixed early in this project: code/robocasa_lerobot_dataset.py copied the raw lerobot 'action' parquet column directly into the model's action-head input, but the on-disk field order did not match the order the model's action head was actually calibrated against. Fixed by adding action_window_to_real_order(); verified via a 15/15 (100%) targeted smoke test before launching the full sweep.

A second issue was found later: the original submission's training data was restricted to the 34 atomic_seen+composite_seen tasks, which the RoboCasa maintainer correctly flagged as not satisfying the official protocol (training must use the full pretrain_human300 corpus). This submission was retrained on the full 300-task corpus and re-evaluated; see lora_plus_m7_pretrain300 above for the real, submittable result.
